title: Beyond-Birthday Related-Key Security for Even–Mansour
summary: A two-round Even–Mansour construction is secure against a restricted XOR-related-key family, but beyond-birthday security against the full family remains open.

formal_statement.body: Construct an Even--Mansour cipher and prove security beyond the birthday bound against the full $\Phi_{\oplus}$ class of related-key attacks. A known partial result proves security for a two-round Even--Mansour construction against $\Phi_{2-\oplus}$-related-key attacks, but does not establish beyond-birthday security against full-fledged $\Phi_{\oplus}$-related-key attacks.

scope.domain: Block-cipher design and related-key security for Even–Mansour constructions.
parameters: Round count — two rounds characterize the known partial construction
Related-key family — a restricted XOR-offset family is covered by the partial result, while the full XOR-offset class is the target
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct an Even–Mansour cipher and prove security beyond the birthday bound against the full Φ⊕ class of related-key attacks.

progress.summary: The paper presents its restricted two-round security result as a partial solution to an open problem and says it falls short of beyond-birthday security against the full Φ⊕ related-key class.
citation_labels: Benoît Cogliati et al., Tweaking Even-Mansour Ciphers
